map.根据管径、流速和管长，估算流量和沿程水头损失: By pipe bore, velocity and length, estimates flow and friction head loss
map.「根据管径、流速和管长，估算流量和沿程水头损失」按输入参数进行专业计算并输出结果: The "Pipe Flow Estimate" performs a professional calculation from your inputs and outputs the result.
map.选入户管径时，用『截面积×经济流速』得流量，匹配高峰用水需求避免水压不足。: For inlet bore, use area x economic velocity for flow, matching peak demand to avoid low pressure.
map.排水管按充满度与坡度核算通水能力，防止堵塞回水。: Drain pipes use fill ratio and slope for capacity, preventing block and backflow.
map.对比 PPR 不同管径的流量差异，选不浪费也不憋水的规格。: Compare PPR bore flows to pick a size that is neither wasteful nor restrictive.
map.DN20 管内径≈21mm，经济流速 1.0m/s\n截面积=π×0.0105²:
DN20 bore ~21mm, economic velocity 1.0m/s
Area = pi x 0.0105^2 ~ 3.46e-4 m2
Flow ~3.46e-4 x 1.0 ~ 0.000346 m3/s ~ 1.25 m3/h
map.给水经济流速约 0.8–1.5m/s，过快噪音水锤、过慢易沉积；本工具按你输入计: Water supply economic velocity ~0.8-1.5m/s; too fast = noise/water-hammer, too slow = deposit; this tool uses your input.
map.流量∝管径²（同流速），所以管径加一点流量增很多；选径别卡太紧。: Flow ~ bore^2 (same velocity), so a little bore adds much flow; do not size too tight.
map.排水和给水算法一样吗？: Same algorithm for drain and supply?
map.不同。排水靠重力与坡度、按充满度算，不加压；本工具给给水模型，排水需另算。: Different. Drain relies on gravity and slope by fill ratio, no pressure; this tool gives the supply model; drain needs separate calc.
map.按管径与流速估算给水管流量，辅助选入户管径与判断水压是否够用。: By bore and velocity estimates supply flow, aiding inlet bore selection and pressure check.
